# utilization of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:utilizationOf`](gmeow-utilizationOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/utilizationOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The location whose utilization is measured. Functional: a utilization measurement concerns exactly one location (constitutive of the measurement's identity).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Utilization`](../classes/gmeow-Utilization.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:utilizationOf`](gmeow-utilizationOf.md) from [`gmeow:Utilization`](../classes/gmeow-Utilization.md) to [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single location a utilization measurement concerns; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid several locations per measurement.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:utilizationOf`](gmeow-utilizationOf.md) per [`Utilization`](../classes/gmeow-Utilization.md).
